notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap with mysql* NSE wildcard against port 3306 tests empty passwords, enumerates users, fingerprints version/capabilities/auth plugin. mysql-info works without credentials — fingerprints server completely unauthenticated.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap mysql* → version + auth plugin + empty password check → connect with mysql client → enumerate databases → harvest credentials → check file operations.
